llmJudgeRequirements.description: Screen state includes separate atoms for draft text posts list and submit lifecycle
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Separate atoms exist for draft text (draftAtom), posts list (postsAtom), and submit lifecycle state (isLoadingAtom, errorAtom).

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Submit action writes pending then commits success or error lifecycle state
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: createPostAtom never calls set(isLoadingAtom, true) for pending or set(isLoadingAtom, false) for completion. isLoadingAtom is declared but never written inside the async atom, so pending state is not managed by the atom itself.
evidence: const createPostAtom = atom(null, async (_get, set, draft: string) => { try { ... } catch { set(errorAtom, err.message) } }) // no set(isLoadingAtom, ...) calls

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Successful mutation appends or prepends created post data and clears draft input atom
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The atom appends the created post via set(postsAtom, ...) on success, but draft reset (setDraft('')) happens in the component handler outside the atom, not inside the write atom itself.
evidence: await createPost(draft); setDraft('') // reset is in component, not in atom

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Submit button triggers the async write atom through `useSetAtom` or `useAtom` dispatch
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The component uses useAtom(createPostAtom) to get the dispatch function and calls it in the submit handler; Pressable's onPress triggers handleSave which dispatches the atom.
